name: Traitor
overview: Scripture reveals the grave nature of betrayal through the example of Judas Iscariot, who treacherously agreed to deliver Jesus for thirty pieces of silver, highlighting the destructive consequences of deceit and falsehood. The Bible warns against walking in the counsel of the ungodly and the snares set by wicked men, emphasizing that lying tongues are fleeting while truth endures. Betrayal not only offends God but also causes division and hatred among people, underscoring the spiritual and relational damage wrought by traitors.
